integrity: Proof is self-contained; standalone exact-rational and matrix tests provide reproducible finite corroboration, not a proof for arbitrary length. Prior exact GAD composition and single-channel PPT formulas are acknowledged; independent originality and proof validation remain outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Only phase-aligned single-qubit generalized amplitude-damping contacts with 0<damping<1 and stationary excited populations in [0,1/2]. Entanglement breaking and negativity are for a definite-order channel acting on one half of a reference pair. No coherent switching, non-Markovian feedback, or parallel entanglement-annihilation assertion. Sorted orders can tie after reaching the entanglement-breaking plateau.
title: Sharp thermal-contact ordering law for qubit entanglement breaking
